text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black came to the racetrack to 
scout out her rivals for the Classic 
Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The foremost rival is "Brusqueman." 
Trained under the "Empress" Air Groove, 
she claims a dominating victory in the 
race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Considered the overwhelming favorite for 
the Classic Triple Crown, Brusqueman's 
camp is surrounded by reporters.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Witnessing that spectacle made Kitasan 
Black painfully aware of the "gap in 
ability" between them.
